tbesh_html:
1) to square, be squared
1a) (Qal) square (participle)
1b) (Pual) square (participle)

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (rather identical with H7250 (רָבַע) through the idea of sprawling 'at all fours' (or possibly the reverse is the order of deriv.); compare H702 (אַרְבַּע)); properly, to be four (sided); used only as denominative of H7253 (רֶבַע);
